Brett Lee Defends Young Cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Amid Age Controversy

Former Australian cricketer Brett Lee has defended 15-year-old Indian cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who is reportedly facing an age debate. Lee stated, "I don't care how old he is," in response to questions about Sooryavanshi's age. The comments came amidst discussions surrounding the young player's age and eligibility. Sooryavanshi is described as an Indian sensation in cricket circles.
